_authored: By hand from the native rollout.jsonl records of this labelled synthetic fixture (record indexes cited), 2026-10-20; a subset pattern compared against AnalysisViews.all, not generated from the views, the adapter or the contract.

_rationale.usage_tranches: 0.8.0-prototype: each Codex TokenUsage reports input_tokens inclusive of cached_input_tokens with cache writes 0, which may be the deserializer's default, so their difference is only the uncached component's conditional value and no view states a canonical uncached tranche (0.6.0 and 0.7.0 stated it); the differences, computed by hand: record 13 1000-500=500, record 16 2100-1500=600, record 30 3300-2500=800, record 35 usage 1200-1000=200, turn 3300-2500=800, thread 5400-4000=1400.
_rationale.submissions: Record 3 is a user-role message whose text starts with <environment_context>: Codex writes it before the prompt; user role alone is not human authorship (classifier codex.user_role_context.v1). Records 5 (response_item message) and 6 (item_completed UserMessage) carry the same text in turn-0001: two representations of one submission. Records 20 and 21 carry identical text in turn-0002: a second submission.
_rationale.responses: Each assistant message is written twice with one id: item_completed AgentMessage (block type Text) then response_item message (block type output_text). The text is equal; the native block structure is not. msg_a_3 (28/29) has the same text as msg_a_1 (7/8) and a different id: a separate response.
_rationale.usage: Turn 1 token_count at record 13 (input 1000) is superseded by record 16 (input 2100) before task_complete 17: 16 is the applicable final, 13 provisional; they are not summed (3100 would be wrong). Turn 2 has one token_count (30, input 3300) before task_complete 31. Record 35 (token_usage_record, added 2026-10-21 in the shape of the real pair B records) reports the cited response msg_a_3 own usage (final at Model-response scope), the turn cumulative so far (provisional, a second observation of the turn-0002 group beside the token_count final) and the thread cumulative (provisional at Session scope, no final): three scopes, never summed.
_rationale.associations: Records 10 and 11 (CommandExecution) carry no call id; their command text occurs in exactly one exec call input of the turn (record 9, call_0001aaaa): a derived unique association, not a reported parent. Records 24 and 25 match two exec calls with identical input (22 call_0002bbbb, 23 call_0003cccc): ambiguous, no tool_call_uid.
_rationale.tool_exchanges: Records 26 and 27 return identical content for call_0002bbbb and call_0003cccc (payload.call_id of each record): kept separate. Record 12 quotes call_FOREIGN0000000000000000 in its text; its owner is call_0001aaaa.
